Plot a network's learned function

Source: R/nnEvalUser.R
plot.nlmixr2nnEval.Rd

Plot a network's learned function

Usage

# S3 method for class 'nlmixr2nnEval'
plot(x, true = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

an `nnEval()` result.

true

optional reference to overlay: a function of the first input, or a numeric vector aligned with the rows of `x`. Use it to compare a learned term against the mechanism that generated the data.

...

passed to the underlying plotting call.

Value

a `ggplot` object when ggplot2 is available, otherwise `NULL` invisibly (the plot is drawn).

Author

Matthew L. Fidler
